ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; investor cycle overdue
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive; investor cycle overdue (investor cycle week 36 · daily cycle day 19).

entry.text: Trend intact — hold; add on dips toward the 10-day average.

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 19 of a typical 36–42 trading days

cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 36 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility

cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.

ladder.why_zh: 周期第 19 天，趋势完好并位于向上的 10 日均线之上，周线仍为混合。

ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量为正；投资者周期已逾期（投资者周期第 36 周 · 日线周期第 19 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上

ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UPTREND signal triggered 3 trading days ago (~2026-06-11), switching from NEARING A LOW. Signal strength: moderate (score +60/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于 3 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-11），自接近低点切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 +60/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱买入形态（+27）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

profile.description: Jabil Inc. is an American multinational manufacturing company involved in the design, engineering, and manufacturing of electronic circuit board assemblies and systems, along with supply chain services, primarily serving original equipment manufacturers.
